A '''planet''' existed during the [[New Sith Wars]]. The [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Finn (Sith)|Finn]] and [[Finn's Sith apprentice|his apprentice]] traveled there and destroyed a building after concluding business with an individual.
